problems.analysis: CouncilAgent._local_council() → deterministic expert scoring over the same ingestion payload; engine field records the substitution.
problems.confidence_note: Algorithmic estimation from pipeline diagnostics — not an absolute scientific proof.
evidence: HTTP 429 'exceeded your current quota' returned by both gemini-3.1-pro-preview and gemini-flash-latest
fix: Retry the pipeline after the 60 s quota window
Stagger Agent 2/3/4 calls (serialize instead of burst)
Enable a billed Gemini project so the 429 never returns
Re-run only the council stage once the key is warmed
problems.impact: No independent LLM cross-verification of formulas, hallucination filtering or score reconciliation; every claim rests on one deterministic audit pass.
problems.root_cause: Gemini free-tier rate limit (~5 req/min/model) exceeded during the parallel agent burst; no API-key tier upgrade is configured.
suggestions: Add an automatic quota-aware queue in main.py
Persist per-model quota state and surface it on the health badge
Keep the local council as the permanent cold-start path
problems.symptom: The Council of 5 could not be executed by Gemini, so verdicts were produced by the deterministic local council.
problems.title: Council verification running in local fallback

problems.analysis: Provenance block is stamped into the payload and rendered as an amber honesty note directly under the chart.
problems.confidence_note: Algorithmic estimation from pipeline diagnostics — not an absolute scientific proof.
evidence: provenance.honesty_note = "Surface reflectance values are documented library reference spectra, NOT a live satellite acquisition; only the reduction pipeline runs on real input."
rasterio / netCDF4 / GDAL are not installed in this environment
fix: Label the widget 'REFERENCE SPECTRA' in the header at all times
Ingest a public L2A COG (e.g. Sentinel-2 L2A on AWS) when GDAL is available
Keep the PCA pipeline unchanged — it is already correct
problems.impact: A reader could mistake the plot for a live satellite product. NDVI/NDWI/NDBI values are correct arithmetic on reference inputs, so they cannot validate any real field site.
problems.root_cause: No access to a Level-2A Sentinel-2 scene; only the reduction pipeline (StandardScaler → PCA) runs on real input.
suggestions: Add a rasterio optional-dependency path guarded by importlib
Store the scene ID + tile/S2 name next to every index
problems.symptom: The radar widget plots documented land-cover reflectance libraries; no Sentinel-2 scene was actually downlinked or read.
problems.title: Multi-spectral profiles are reference spectra, not imagery

problems.analysis: Same payload re-scored with StandardScaler → IsolationForest; the caveat string is injected into dataset_summary.cleaning so the council sees it.
problems.confidence_note: Algorithmic estimation from pipeline diagnostics — not an absolute scientific proof.
evidence: cleaning log caveat: "flags ~10% of rows BY CONSTRUCTION"
fix: Re-run with contamination='auto' and compare the flag rate
Publish the decision-function histogram, not a count
Rename the metric to `qc_review_sample` in the UI
problems.impact: Readers may interpret the flagged set as a discovery rate. Any downstream 'KPI of anomalies' derived from it is meaningless.
problems.root_cause: contamination was pinned to a constant instead of being estimated (e.g. contamination='auto' or an empirical threshold on the decision-function distribution).
suggestions: Add a second, unsupervised detector (DBSCAN / Mahalanobis) and report only the intersection as high-confidence
Never expose anomaly_count as a headline number
problems.symptom: IsolationForest is configured with contamination=0.1, so ~10% of rows are flagged regardless of whether any anomaly exists.
problems.title: Anomaly count is methodologically forced, not discovered

problems.analysis: Union of calendar days is padded with `no_data:true` so the axis stays continuous while nulls remain visible and unplottable.
problems.confidence_note: Algorithmic estimation from pipeline diagnostics — not an absolute scientific proof.
evidence: daily buckets = 31, of which 13 carry no Kp (42%)
fix: Restrict the correlation statistic to the overlap window only
Fetch Kp from a longer archive (SWPC 1-minute/1-day products)
Render the overlap region as a shaded band on the chart
problems.impact: Any 'flare vs Kp' correlation computed over the full 30 days would be dominated by nulls and could imply a coupling that is not there.
problems.root_cause: Two providers with different native retention windows were merged into one daily axis without an explicit overlap mask.
suggestions: Add a second geomagnetic index (Dst/Kp hybrid) for the missing span
Expose `coverage_window` in the payload so the UI can label it
problems.symptom: NOAA SWPC returns ~7.7 days of 3-hourly Kp while DONKI returns 30 days of flares, so the dual-axis correlation is only valid for the overlapping tail.
problems.title: Kp index window much shorter than the flare window

problems.analysis: SNR is read from the traceable CSV rather than hardcoded, and the ratio is recomputed on every run.
problems.confidence_note: Algorithmic estimation from pipeline diagnostics — not an absolute scientific proof.
evidence: rms_mag = 0.0040 mag, signal_mag from the reference document
anomaly_count = 167 rows already flagged for QC review
fix: Apply a systematic-removal step (PLD or CBV) before SNR
Bin to the cadence where photon noise dominates
Report SNR as a function of bin size, not a single scalar
problems.impact: Phase folding degrades and small-transit detection completeness falls; noise floor σ limits the detectable planet radius.
problems.root_cause: Reference observation window assumes a modest aperture/seeing profile; no detrending (CBV/PLD) is applied before the SNR ratio.
suggestions: Add a second reference metric for the detrended SNR
Flag the target as marginal when SNR < 30 on the Astronomy page
problems.symptom: The reference light curve has a signal/rms ratio that leaves little room for transit ingress/egress fitting at short cadence.
problems.title: Light-curve SNR leaves limited photometric headroom
